# Cressida Lindsay

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 c5 P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>
- **Origin:** Mount Holly, Harborough  <sub>[v3 c21 P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>
- **Role:** Freshman and student at Wexcombe College  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c7 P0](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** belle and beauty of the class  <sub>[v3 c6 P13](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0013)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cressy  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>; Cressida Lindsay  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>; Cressy Hale  <sub>[v3 c41 P31](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0031)</sub>

## Appearance

Cressida is a beauty with large brown eyes, a lopsided smile, and curls. At her wedding she resembled a delicate, ethereal fairy. Later, after giving birth to infants, she described herself as having grown dreadfully skinny.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c27 P3](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0003), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044)_

## Personality

Cressy possesses a loyal, generous, and entirely unsnobbish nature, despite her elite social background. She is charming, lighthearted, and entertaining, enjoying social festivities and the attention of numerous suitors. Though sometimes thoughtless, dramatic, and indecisive when choosing between romantic admirers, she holds no grudges, dislikes disagreeable topics, and remains composed during unexpected panics.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c7 P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 c10 P53](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0053), [v3 c10 P65](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0065), [v3 c20 P3](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0003), [v3 c20 P7](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0007), [v3 c36 P23](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0023)_

## History

As a wealthy freshman at Wexcombe College, Cressy quickly befriended Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis, effortlessly bringing them into her expansive social sphere. Highly popular, she was courted by many suitors, particularly Hector and Orlando. She moved into Tabby's Place with Nell, Honora, and Mabel Colby, acquiring domestic skills such as sweeping and dishwashing to adapt to their modest lifestyle. During a summer stay at Prospect Point, she met the Rev. Ezra Hale, with whom she quickly fell in love and sought a proposal. Despite initial opposition from her mother, she successfully stood her ground and gained her family's approval. Cressy excelled academically, earning Honors in Mathematics at graduation. In June following her final year, she married Ezra with Nell serving as her bridesmaid. Later, she wrote to Hugh Carrow to clarify Nell's romantic status, encouraging him to pursue her, and eventually visited Grey Shutters after having children.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c7 P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 c10 P52](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0052), [v3 c16 P66](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0066), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c25 P23](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0023), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 c41 P31](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0031), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044)_
